summary: This directory serves as the foundation for TypeScript-based analysis by providing core data structures, type definitions, and schema validation logic. It establishes the common models and identification systems used to represent and process source files, symbols, and project metadata.
responsibilities: Define structural interfaces for file and symbol analysis contexts
Provide unique identification types for symbols and signatures
Standardize relative path representations across different root scopes
Validate and enforce supported schema types for analysis
Aggregate and export shared models for dependency and package metadata processing
relationships: The FileAnalysisContext aggregates documentable targets and metadata to represent the state of an analyzed source file.
SymbolId and SignatureId provide unique identity tracking across the analysis pipeline for members and code constructs.
SupportedSchemaKind restricts the allowed schema types during the analysis of package and configuration data.
Relative path types ensure consistent referencing of files across different workspace and project contexts.
designDecisions: Use of nominal branding for path and identifier types to ensure type safety
Centralized type definitions to promote consistent data representation
Modular export strategy allowing for granular access to analysis sub-domains
Strict separation between analysis metadata and transient state data
